extras.description: To prevent mold inside the air conditioner, when the air conditioner is stopped after running in cool or dry mode for more than 5 minutes, it automatically operates to dry the inside.
Immediately after starting operation, the set temperature is raised by 1°C, then lowered by 2°C, and then raised by 2°C by the wake-up time. Can only be used in cool or warm mode.
Blows air at a higher temperature than normal warm mode for about 30 minutes.
Humidifies a room by drawing in moisture from the outside air to create a set humidity level. Can only be used in warm mode.
Lower the humidity in the room.
Quickly change the room temperature by changing the temperature setting to 18°C for cool mode and to 30°C for warm mode.
To prevent mold inside the air conditioner, when the air conditioner is stopped after running in cool or dry mode for more than 5 minutes, it automatically operates to dry the inside.
Voice response when the air conditioner is operated.
